question: Should ClawHub land a stricter no-case-colliding package-file rule for SKILL.md, skills.md, and PROTOCOL.md now, with docs/spec updates and browser proof required before merge?
rationale: The code shape is plausible, but this changes the published package contract and PROTOCOL.md scope while the PR is also conflicting with current staged publish work.

options.title: Document and prove strict gate
options.body: Require a current-main rebase, docs/spec coverage for the no-case-collision rule, and real browser proof for web upload before merging.

options.title: Accept code-only compatibility break
options.body: Maintainers can choose to land the stricter gate after rebase without additional package-contract documentation, accepting support risk for newly blocked packages.

options.title: Narrow the package scope
options.body: Pause or revise the PR if PROTOCOL.md collision enforcement should not be part of this skill package rule yet.

recommendation.title: Document and prove strict gate
recommendation.body: Require a current-main rebase, docs/spec coverage for the no-case-collision rule, and real browser proof for web upload before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current publish-path history and authored the new staged prepublication path that must be reconciled before merge.
